query: What is the multiplayer experience like in Call of Duty: Warzone?
query_zh: Call of Duty: Warzone 的多人游戏体验如何？

query: Is Left 4 Dead 2 still fun to play with friends?
query_zh: Left 4 Dead 2 现在和朋友一起玩还好玩吗？

query: How do reviewers rate the narrative of Red Dead Redemption 2?

query: How does the combat feel in Hades II?

query: How do the controls feel in Hollow Knight: Silksong?

query: Is Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown well optimized?

query: RollerCoaster Tycoon World camera and building controls

query: What do longtime fans think of the gameplay changes in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War III?

query: What is GTA Online like in Grand Theft Auto V Legacy?
query_zh: Grand Theft Auto V Legacy 中的 GTA Online 体验如何？

draft_reference_summary_zh: GTA Online 的乐趣来自劫案、生意、竞速，以及与朋友自由活动的空间，但成长过程也可能需要反复刷取。公开战局的另一面则是混乱、作弊模组和恶意干扰，这些问题会明显破坏体验。

query: PAYDAY 3 heist gameplay
query_zh: PAYDAY 3 的劫案玩法怎么样？

The skill trees also feel dull despite the stronger moment-to-moment play.
draft_reference_summary_zh: PAYDAY 3 的劫案体验受益于扎实的射击手感和改进后的潜行，后续调整也提升了游玩乐趣。不足主要在于持续游玩的吸引力：高赞评论批评内容有限、劫案变化不足，多次通关后容易重复。技能树也显得乏味，与较好的即时战斗体验形成落差。

query: Does Redfall have a good story?

query: Umbrella Corps gameplay mechanics
query_zh: Umbrella Corps 的玩法机制如何？
draft_reference_summary: Umbrella Corps mixes an arcade-shooter campaign about collecting samples from defeated enemies with unusual combat mechanics. draft_reference_summary_zh: Umbrella Corps 的单人战役以街机射击和收集被击倒敌人的样本为核心，并加入一些特殊战斗机制。射击、关卡和不同玩法选择有其吸引力，但内容重复、打磨不足，以及作用有限的丧尸机制，也使整体体验分歧明显。

query: How does co-op work in Wolfenstein: Youngblood?

query: Is there enough to do in Spacebase DF-9?
query_zh: Spacebase DF-9 的可玩内容足够吗？

query: How is the asymmetric gameplay in Resident Evil Resistance?
query_zh: Resident Evil Resistance 的非对称玩法体验如何？

draft_reference_summary_zh: Resident Evil Resistance 的非对称概念有吸引力，团队配合完成逃脱时尤其能带来紧张而混乱的乐趣。但幸存者与操纵者之间的失衡、重复感和未完成的体验，使这个创意难以稳定发挥。

query: What technical problems ruin RollerCoaster Tycoon World?

query: Why do players love the music in Hades II?

query_zh: 玩家喜欢 Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown 引擎声和音乐的哪些方面？

query: What do players enjoy about the hunts and weapons in Monster Hunter Wilds?
query_zh: 玩家喜欢 Monster Hunter Wilds 狩猎和武器的哪些方面？
draft_reference_summary: Monster Hunter Wilds' hunts benefit from smooth, intuitive combat and enjoyable monster encounters. Focus mode helps with aiming, while the wound mechanic adds different effects across weapons.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Monster Hunter Wilds 的狩猎乐趣来自流畅、直观的战斗，以及与大型怪物交手的体验。集中模式有助于瞄准，伤口机制在不同武器上产生的不同效果，也增加了玩法吸引力。

query: Why do players say Hollow Knight's controls feel tight and responsive?
query_zh: 玩家为什么认为 Hollow Knight 的操作紧凑、反应灵敏？
draft_reference_summary: Hollow Knight's controls feel tight because actions respond closely to player input and support smooth combat, with simple controller operation adding to the sense of responsiveness.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Hollow Knight 的操作之所以显得精准，在于动作能够贴近玩家输入、战斗衔接流畅；手柄操作的简洁性，也增强了这种反应灵敏的体验。

query: What do players dislike about the driving and progression in Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown?
query_zh: 玩家不喜欢 Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown 驾驶和成长系统的哪些方面？
draft_reference_summary: Solar Crown frustrates players with weak handling and slow progression. Level-gated unlocks and repetitive early races make earning cars and customization time-consuming, while stock-car requirements reduce the value of upgrades. Uninspired missions, distractions from driving and an overly easy, unchangeable difficulty add to the complaints.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Solar Crown 的主要不满集中在车辆操控欠佳和成长缓慢。等级限制与前期重复竞赛，让车辆和自定义内容的解锁耗时较长；部分比赛要求原厂车，也削弱了升级的意义。缺乏创意的任务、偏离驾驶重点的活动，以及过低且无法调整的难度，又进一步影响了体验。

query: Why does RollerCoaster Tycoon World lag with big parks?
query_zh: RollerCoaster Tycoon World 为什么在大型公园中卡顿？
draft_reference_summary: RollerCoaster Tycoon World's large-park lag is blamed on poor optimization even on good hardware, and a highly upvoted review also reports slowdown when moving the camera; the accounts do not identify a deeper technical cause.
draft_reference_summary_zh: RollerCoaster Tycoon World 的大型公园卡顿被归因于优化不足，即使硬件较好也会出现；一条高赞评论还提到移动镜头时卡顿，但这些反馈没有指出更具体的技术原因。

query: Why is it so hard to find a match in Umbrella Corps?
query_zh: Umbrella Corps 为什么难以找到对局？
draft_reference_summary: Finding an Umbrella Corps match is difficult because the online population is described as largely inactive, while starting a match still requires three other players.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Umbrella Corps 难以找到对局，主要是因为线上玩家群体已经很不活跃，而一场比赛仍需要另外三名玩家才能开始。

query: What do players dislike about the story of Hades II compared to the first game?
query_zh: 玩家认为 Hades II 的剧情相比前作有哪些不足？
draft_reference_summary: Compared with the first Hades, Hades II is criticized for weaker characters, story, world-building and narrative depth. Broader dissatisfaction with the writing also appears alongside those sequel comparisons.
draft_reference_summary_zh: 与初代 Hades 相比，Hades II 的角色、剧情、世界塑造和叙事深度，被部分体验认为有所减弱。除了前后作比较，也存在对写作本身不够出色的不满。

query: Why do players dislike the leveling and bullet-sponge enemies in Wolfenstein: Youngblood?
query_zh: 玩家为什么不喜欢 Wolfenstein: Youngblood 的等级系统和子弹海绵敌人？
draft_reference_summary: Youngblood's leveling and ammunition-type systems are disliked for making enemies absorb too many hits and reducing shooting satisfaction. Grinding, level-gated abilities, repetitive missions and inconsistent enemy health or damage make the progression feel more frustrating.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Youngblood 的等级与弹药类型系统，使敌人显得过于耐打，也削弱了射击的满足感。反复刷取、能力受等级限制、任务重复，以及敌人血量和伤害不一致，又进一步增加了成长过程中的挫败感。

query: What do players criticize about Redfall's visuals?
query_zh: 玩家批评 Redfall 画面的哪些方面？
draft_reference_summary: Redfall's visuals draw criticism for graphical bugs and unattractive graphics in highly upvoted reviews, while its art style and character models also fail to appeal in another account.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Redfall 的高赞评论主要批评图形 Bug 和画面难看，另有反馈也不喜欢它的美术风格与角色模型。

query: What bugs and crashes do players report in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War III?
query_zh: 玩家在 Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War III 中报告了哪些 Bug 和崩溃？
draft_reference_summary: Dawn of War III has reports of frequent bugs and crashes, including crashes back to Windows almost once per mission.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Dawn of War III 存在频繁故障和崩溃的反馈，严重时几乎每个任务都会出问题并崩溃返回 Windows。

query: What do players dislike about the progression and heists in PAYDAY 3?
query_zh: 玩家不喜欢 PAYDAY 3 成长系统和劫案的哪些方面？
draft_reference_summary: PAYDAY 3's progression and heists are held back by limited content and unresolved progression problems. Reduced heist randomness compared with PAYDAY 2 also hurts variety, even where movement and gunplay are preferred.
draft_reference_summary_zh: PAYDAY 3 的成长与劫案体验受到内容有限、成长系统问题未解决的影响。与 PAYDAY 2 相比，劫案随机性减少也削弱了变化，即使移动和射击本身更受喜欢。

query: Is Cyberpunk 2077 finally fixed: does it run well, and are the bugs gone?
query_zh: Cyberpunk 2077 终于修好了吗：运行良好、Bug 都消失了吗？
draft_reference_summary: Cyberpunk 2077 is not uniformly fixed across the reported setups: minimal issues after a late purchase coexist with an account of failing to run the game even at the lowest settings.
draft_reference_summary_zh: 从这些配置体验来看，Cyberpunk 2077 尚不能被概括为已经完全修好：既有较晚购买后几乎没遇到问题的体验，也有最低设置下仍无法运行的情况。
assistant_review_note: Minimal issues after a later purchase is an individual experience, not proof of a universally fixed version.
assistant_review_note_zh: 较晚购买后问题很少，只是一位玩家的体验，不能证明所有配置上的游戏问题都已修好。

query: How do the gunplay and visuals of Wolfenstein: Youngblood hold up?
query_zh: Wolfenstein: Youngblood 的射击手感和画面如何？
draft_reference_summary: Youngblood offers solid, more dynamic gunplay in positive accounts, although losing dual-wielded two-handed weapons is a disappointment. Bullet-sponge enemies, repetitive play and progression restrictions work against those strengths. Its graphics range from acceptable or good to a perceived step down in visual and level design from earlier games.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Youngblood 的积极体验在于扎实、更灵活的射击，不过失去双持双手武器也令人遗憾。过于耐打的敌人、重复玩法和成长限制，又抵消了这些优点。画面评价则从尚可、不错，到认为视觉与关卡设计不如前作，存在明显分歧。

query: Is Resident Evil Resistance balanced, and does it work without technical problems?
query_zh: Resident Evil Resistance 平衡吗，是否没有技术问题？
draft_reference_summary: Resident Evil Resistance's balance is criticized as uneven between survivors and masterminds, with long matchmaking waits and a diminished population adding to the friction. A highly upvoted review describes door-blocking zombie exploits and cheating programs that disrupt play. Successful coordinated escapes can still be fun, but do not remove the imbalance or repetition.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Resident Evil Resistance 的幸存者与操纵者之间存在失衡，较长的匹配等待和减少的玩家人数，又增加了游玩阻力。一条高赞评论还批评了利用丧尸堵门的漏洞，以及破坏体验的作弊程序。团队配合成功逃脱时仍能带来乐趣，但失衡和重复感并未因此消失。

query: Is Spacebase DF-9 unfinished: how much content is there, and does it crash?
query_zh: Spacebase DF-9 是否未完成：内容有多少，会崩溃吗？
draft_reference_summary: Spacebase DF-9 feels unfinished because its content, management tools and lasting activities are limited. Game-breaking bugs, launch freezes and crashes can also stop progress, including a session that became unusable after 13 hours. The space-station simulation still has appeal, but its potential is constrained by those shortcomings.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Spacebase DF-9 的未完成感主要来自内容、经营工具和可持续活动不足。严重 Bug、启动卡死和崩溃还可能直接阻断进度，包括游玩 13 小时后无法继续的体验。空间站模拟本身依然有吸引力，但这些问题限制了它的潜力。

query: How do the driving controls and frame rate feel in Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown?
query_zh: Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown 的驾驶操作和帧率如何？
draft_reference_summary: Solar Crown's driving is divisive, with criticism of handling alongside enjoyment of early cars and the different feel of older vehicles. Performance reports include an RTX 3070/Ryzen 5 5600X setup initially unable to hold 60 FPS at 1080p with minimum settings and heavy DLSS, followed by substantial improvement in a February 2026 edit. Other experiences remain poor, including a drop to five frames after fast travel.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Solar Crown 的驾驶体验存在分歧，车辆操控受到批评，但早期车辆的手感和老车之间的不同感受，也有受到肯定的部分。性能方面，RTX 3070 与 Ryzen 5 5600X 有在最低设置、高度依赖 DLSS 时，1080p 仍无法稳定达到 60 FPS 的早期记录；同一评论在 2026 年 2 月更新中又报告了显著改善。不过，其他体验仍不理想，包括快速移动后降到 5 帧的情况。
assistant_review_note: Retain early-car and February-2026 update qualifications; different reports should not be merged into one hardware setup.
assistant_review_note_zh: 请保留早期车辆、2026 年 2 月更新等条件；不要把不同玩家的报告合并成同一套硬件体验。

query: How do the story and combat of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 compare?
query_zh: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 的剧情和战斗相比如何？
draft_reference_summary: Expedition 33's emotional storytelling is a major strength, although a slower middle section and waning interest around Act 3 temper that praise. Its distinctive turn-based combat with real-time parrying and dodging is similarly divisive: rewarding challenge for some becomes exhausting timing pressure for others.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Expedition 33 的情感叙事是明显优势，不过中段节奏放缓，以及第三幕前后吸引力下降的体验，也让好评带有限定。回合制与实时招架、闪避结合的战斗同样存在分歧：有体验认为挑战令人满足，也有体验觉得时机要求过严、容易疲惫。

query: How are the multiplayer matches and MOBA-style gameplay in Dawn of War III?
query_zh: Dawn of War III 的多人对局和 MOBA 式玩法如何？
draft_reference_summary: Dawn of War III's MOBA-style maps, smaller battles and hero-and-creep management are criticized as an unsatisfying direction for the series. Matches can still be fun or challenging with friends, although difficult defeats also appear in the accounts. Base-building is regarded more favorably in one comparison, improving on Dawn of War II without matching the original game's depth.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Dawn of War III 的 MOBA 式地图、小规模战斗，以及英雄和小兵管理，被批评为不够令人满意的系列方向。与朋友一起对战仍可能有趣、有挑战，但也存在被严重击败的体验。基地建设在一项前作比较中更受肯定，比 Dawn of War II 有进步，却仍不如初代深入。

query: Is Call of Duty: Warzone stable and smooth to play?
query_zh: Call of Duty: Warzone 玩起来稳定、流畅吗？
draft_reference_summary: Warzone's smoothness is undermined in the reported experience by lag, packet bursts, desynchronization, disconnects and updates that introduce problems. A separate 65–75 FPS report at maximum settings without upscaling shows that performance can differ, rather than establishing consistent stability.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Warzone 的流畅体验会受到延迟、数据包突发、不同步、断线和更新引入问题的影响。另一方面，也有最高设置、不启用分辨率放大时达到 65–75 FPS 的记录，说明性能体验存在差异，不能直接概括为稳定流畅。

query: Which games are polished and almost free of bugs?
query_zh: 哪些游戏打磨较好、几乎没有 Bug？
draft_reference_summary: The evidence includes bug-free or crash-free experiences with Resident Evil Resistance, Cyberpunk 2077 and PAYDAY 3, with a highly upvoted PAYDAY 3 review specifically reporting no bugs or server issues. Monster Hunter Wilds is also described as polished and free of game-breaking bugs in an account played at reduced graphical fidelity.
draft_reference_summary_zh: 证据中，Resident Evil Resistance、Cyberpunk 2077 和 PAYDAY 3 都有无 Bug 或无崩溃的体验，其中一条 PAYDAY 3 高赞评论明确表示没有 Bug 和服务器问题。Monster Hunter Wilds 也有在降低画质后，认为打磨较好、没有严重影响游玩的 Bug 的反馈。
assistant_review_note: Bug-free descriptions are attributed individual experiences, not independently verified absence of all bugs.
assistant_review_note_zh: 没有 Bug 的描述属于个体体验，并不是经独立验证的完全无 Bug 结论。

query: Which games are great to play co-op with friends?
query_zh: 哪些游戏适合与朋友合作游玩？
draft_reference_summary: Left 4 Dead 2 and PAYDAY 3 are recommended for shared play with friends. Monster Hunter Wilds adds cooperative hunts, while GTA Online offers group heists, races and other activities.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Left 4 Dead 2 和 PAYDAY 3 都适合与朋友一起游玩。Monster Hunter Wilds 的特色是合作狩猎，GTA Online 则提供组队劫案、竞速和其他共同活动。

query: games with bad voice acting or annoying sound
query_zh: 哪些游戏的配音差或声音令人烦躁？
draft_reference_summary: Dawn of War III and Youngblood draw complaints about voice acting that feels weak, awkward or unengaging. Other sound-related frustrations include a PAYDAY 3 dub and an irritating robot voice in Solar Crown.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Dawn of War III 和 Youngblood 的配音被批评为表现薄弱、尴尬，或缺乏感染力。其他声音方面的不满还包括 PAYDAY 3 的一版配音，以及 Solar Crown 中令人烦躁的机器人声音。

query: Which games are well optimized and run smoothly?
query_zh: 哪些游戏优化好、运行流畅？
draft_reference_summary: Resident Evil Requiem and Left 4 Dead 2 receive optimization praise, with Requiem accounts including smooth 1440p play on a five-year-old PC and performance above 100 FPS. Cyberpunk 2077 has smooth-play reports on Linux and a full AMD setup, while Monster Hunter Wilds receives positive feedback after an optimization update. Red Dead Redemption 2 without frame generation and GTA V Legacy provide further examples of smooth PC play.
draft_reference_summary_zh: Resident Evil Requiem 和 Left 4 Dead 2 都因优化受到肯定，前者有使用五年的 PC 流畅运行 1440p，以及帧率超过 100 FPS 的记录。Cyberpunk 2077 在 Linux 和全 AMD 配置上有流畅运行的反馈，Monster Hunter Wilds 则有优化更新后表现良好的体验。Red Dead Redemption 2 不依赖帧生成的流畅表现，以及 GTA V Legacy 的 PC 体验，也提供了其他例子。
